season_start_note: Episode 1 is pay-out day at teghra more, Chait, and it is a Tuesday.

dates_fixed_by_this_batch.what: Holi. dhaniram tells birju there will be an appointment letter with his name typed on it. No date is given for the letter.
dates_fixed_by_this_batch.spoken_as: "At Holi you said there would be a letter"

dates_fixed_by_this_batch.what: The raid at chandwa: a magistrate and two buses take 137 people — 40 men, 46 women, 51 children — out of a kiln four hours from teghra more.
dates_fixed_by_this_batch.spoken_as: "a raid at Chandwa on the seventeenth" / "the seventeenth was last Tuesday"

dates_fixed_by_this_batch.what: Pay-out day. birju is handed the blank book, reads eleven houses aloud, and reads 89,400 against his own.
The ration queue at the crossing. chameli's father calls the marriage off out loud and gives the figure as 89,400.
The night before the queue: chameli's father tells chameli at home that the marriage will not happen, and gives the reason as a number.
Night. tirath comes drunk to the kiln gate, is refused and sent home, and passes birju the torn page numbered 411.
dates_fixed_by_this_batch.spoken_as: night, two nights after the crossing

dates_fixed_by_this_batch.what: Eight o'clock at the crossing — the meeting tirath proposes as he leaves. Not yet dramatised.
dates_fixed_by_this_batch.spoken_as: "I will be at the crossing, sober, at eight o'clock"

periods_fixed_by_this_batch.label: Bhado, Kuar, Katik, Aghan 2025
periods_fixed_by_this_batch.what: The four months tirath says he was never paid. He was sacked in Aghan.

periods_fixed_by_this_batch.label: Phagun 2026
periods_fixed_by_this_batch.what: The month devlal says a hen walked over the drying bricks, for which a 10,000 fine stands against a household. Asserted by devlal, not narrated.

periods_fixed_by_this_batch.label: twenty-two seasons before the present
periods_fixed_by_this_batch.what: sanichari's household takes 4,800 rupees for a burning and she is promised a release paper in the yard. Both are her spoken account.

periods_fixed_by_this_batch.label: Baisakh 2026
periods_fixed_by_this_batch.what: The month by which sudama says he will buy his mother out of the book. Also the month the marriage was to have happened.

periods_fixed_by_this_batch.label: two years before the present
periods_fixed_by_this_batch.what: The marriage between birju and chameli is arranged at the crossing.

deliberately_not_fixed.item: The year of phulwa's thumbprint on the line above 89,400.
deliberately_not_fixed.rendered_as: "nine years before Birju learned to hold a pen"
deliberately_not_fixed.why: The dossier states birju is twenty-one and also that he read a paper to his mother in 2009 at the age of twelve, and the season plan requires the present to be roughly fifty-one years after 1974. Those three cannot all be true. This batch delivers the assigned ends_on without fixing a year, so a later batch can settle it without contradicting anything already emitted.

deliberately_not_fixed.item: The year of birju's birth and the year he became literate.
deliberately_not_fixed.why: Same contradiction. No age in years is stated in the prose of episodes 1-3.
